text.tspan: Every pod in ONE namespace not ready at once? Look at what they SHARE
How does it fail? describe pod events: HTTP 503 = app says not ready (dependency) · timeout = slow / throttled · refused = not listening
Then exec in: wget localhost:8080/ready · nslookup <dep> · nc -zv <dep> 5432 · compare with other namespaces (fine = namespace-scoped cause)
Fix: roll back the change (helm rollback / argocd / kubectl rollout undo) or fix the dependency.
Lesson: readiness should check what THIS pod needs, not every dependency deeply. Liveness never checks dependencies.
